identificationModule.briefTitle: Penpulimab Combined With Chemotherapy for Neoadjuvant and Adjuvant Therapy in Patients With Resectable HNSCC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Clinical Study of Penpulimab Combined With Chemotherapy for Neoadjuvant and Adjuvant Therapy in Patients With Resectable Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

leadSponsor.name: Shanghai Ninth People's Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study aims to observe and explore the efficacy and safety of Penpulimab combined with chemotherapy for neoadjuvant and adjuvant therapy in patients with resectable head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

conditions: Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

armGroups.label: Penpulimab combined with cisplatin and albumin-paclitaxel neoadjuvant therapy
armGroups.description:
Penpulimab injection combined with cis-platinum and albumin-bound paclitaxel before surgery, 21 days as a treatment cycle.

Adjuvant therapy was started within 6 weeks after surgery：Patients who achieved MPR after surgery were randomized 1:1 with standard adjuvant therapy(RT alone or combined with cisplatin) and Alternative adjuvant therapy(RT alone or combined with Penpulimab).

Non-MPR patients receive standard adjuvant therapy

interventions.name: Penpulimab injection
interventions.description: Penpulimab is a human immunoglobulin G1(IgG1) monoclonal antibody (mAb) directly programmed cell death-1 (PD-1). AK105 can effectively prevent human PD-1 binds to programmed cell death-1 ligand 1(PD-L1) and programmed cell death-1 ligand 2(PD-L2)； 200mg,D1, IV(21 days/cycle).

primaryOutcomes.description: Major pathologic response is based on the pathological examination on the post-operative specimens.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of subjects response of CR, PR, or SD (subjects achieving SD will be included in the DCR if they maintain SD for ≥4 weeks).
The occurrence of all adverse events (AEs), serious adverse events (SAEs) and treatment-related adverse events (TEAEs).

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Disease-free survival at 2 years(DFS at 2 years)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of subjects disease-free survival at 2 years
The proportion of subjects who achieves a best overall response of CR or PR.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Local recurrence-free survival at 2years(LRFS at 2 years)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of subjects local recurrence-free survival at 2years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: distant metastasis-free survival at 2 years(DMFS at 2 years)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of subjects distant metastasis-free survival at 2years
The overall survival time refers to the time from initiating inductive therapy to death due to any cause.
Pathological examination showed the presence of 0% active tumor in the tissue specimen
